item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"For all four category models, retain 90% of the existing weighted objective and add 10% uniform pairwise softplus loss using the same sampled scores. This adds direct ranking pressure across valid positions without changing the sampler, architecture, or inference.","edits":[{"find":"    return (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()","replace":"    existing_loss = (weights * pairwise_loss).sum()\n    auxiliary_loss = pairwise_loss.mean()\n    return 0.9 * existing_loss + 0.1 * auxiliary_loss"}]}],"change_summary":"Changed only the shared training loss to 0.9 times the existing objective plus 0.1 times mean pairwise softplus loss.
